profiles.name: Plausible Analytics
profiles.why: Both companies market themselves as cookieless, EU-based, GDPR-aligned alternatives to Google Analytics: Plausible says visitor data is 'exclusively processed on servers owned and operated by European companies and never leaves the EU' (plausible.io), while Simple Analytics is 'EU-hosted' with 'All analytics data... processed in the Netherlands' (E18) and is 'GDPR compliant from installation' (E6). This shared EU-hosting/no-consent-banner positioning is a documented reason the two are grouped in privacy-analytics comparisons, though their published entry prices differ in plan, currency and volume: Plausible's Starter tier is $9/month shown at up to 10k monthly pageviews, while Simple Analytics' Self-serve plan is €20/month estimated for about 100k monthly pageviews (E2).
profiles.discovery_reason: The default name that comes up alongside Simple Analytics in nearly every 'cookieless/privacy analytics' comparison a buyer searches for.
profiles.one_liner: Plausible is powerful, lightweight analytics. No cookies, just insights.
profiles.promise: Plausible is a simple, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics that doesn't cut corners — clear, useful insights without complexity, training or prior analytics experience.
profiles.pricing: Usage-tiered by monthly pageviews, shown at the 10k-pageview tier: Starter $9/month (one site), Growth $14/month (up to 3 sites), Business $19/month (up to 10 sites), Enterprise custom (10+ sites); annual billing offers 2 months free; Enterprise is quote-only.
profiles.free_entry: 30-day free trial, no credit card required.
profiles.icp: Google Analytics is overkill for most site owners; Plausible markets to those wanting clear, useful insights without complexity, training or prior analytics experience, from small sites up to hundreds of millions of monthly visitors.
